simple.summary: כּוֹבַע (kôwbaʻ) means a helmet (as arched ) First listed occurrence: 1Sam 17 5.

definitions.full: H3553. koba כּוֺבַע noun masculine helmet (√ dubious; Late Hebrew כּוֺבַע , Aramaic כּוֺבְעָא turban ; compare קוֺבַע Ezek 23:24 ) — absolute ׳כ 27:10 ; כּוֺבָ֑ע 38:5 ; construct כּ֫וֺבַע (Ew § 213, f. ) 1Sam 17:5 ; Isa 59:17 ; plural כּוֺבָעִים Jer 46:4 ; 2Chr 26:14 ; — helmet , of bronze ׳כ עַלרֿאֹשׁוֺ נְחשֶׁת 1Sam 17:5 ; Jer 46:4 ; Ezek 27:10 ; 38:5 ; 2Chr 26:14 ; figurative of בְּראֹשׁוֺ וְכ כַּשִּׁרְיָן צְדָקָה ׳וַיִּלְבַּשׁ יְשׁוּעָה ׳י, Isa 59:17 .
